title: Baton with a knife
kid_text: A grown-up hits the knife with a stick.
safety: A folder can close on your hand. Use a fixed blade.
Keep your legs out of the swing.

steps.text: Grip the knife the safe way.
Use a fixed blade. Never use a folder.
Set the blade on the end of the wood.
Strike the spine past the wood, not the handle.
Keep your hands and legs clear.

mistakes.fix: Strike the spine past the wood.
